text: I needed a straightforward way to let customers personalize products on my store, and this app has been a good fit. Having the text fields, color choices, and image uploads together makes the options easier to manage. The live preview is the part I find most useful - it helps customers see what they’re choosing before placing an order. So far, I’m happy with how it fits into my product pages.

Tried around 10 shopify custom product options app and finally settled to this app. Their demo store use cases helped me to get clear ideas how we need to set right options for any custom products. Overall design and performance is very responsive. Their templates help me to run away from the manual setting. Great support team as well.

Best app out there on the market for add-ons. I tried ALL of add-on apps and this one is easy to set-up, navigate and use. Best of all, the customer service is very responsive and helpful. I had some issues with my Swedish page where the code wouldn't work correctly and they helped to figure it out at the spot and solved it for me. Great experience and very nice support!

Great support team! The app offers all the additional features we needed, with plenty of customization options to suit specific requirements. The team is also very responsive and provides timely support whenever needed. This is one of the best apps for custom product options we’ve used so far. Thank you, WOW Options team, for making the entire process smooth and hassle-free!

Outstanding app! The UI is clean, intuitive, and very easy to work with. Setting up product options was quick and straightforward and it gave me the flexibility I needed without making things complicated. What really stands out is how reliable and well-designed the app is. It integrates seamlessly with my store and the overall user experience is excellent. I highly recommend WowOptions.
We tested about 12 bundle style apps before choosing this one. Awesome App! Does exactly what we need and SUPER easy to use.

Great app to add options to your product very easily. Razibul Hasan reach out to me to help me position my options on my website at it look wonderful. I really appreciate the help and recommend this app! Easy to use and great support form the staff.
A very reliable and well designed app. Lots of product options in the free version; enough to start and scale a business. Overall, a very good experience.

Wow Custom Product Options is life saver for us. We wanted a all-in-one custom product options app with live personalizer at low cost and this app actually serves what we needed. Clean design, easy to understand and useful. Satisfied highly recommended.
App works like a charm. Great customer support so far as well. Recommend.

A fantastic app with excellent functionality! It is easy to use, works smoothly, and provides plenty of flexibility for creating custom product options. The support team is incredibly responsive, friendly, and always ready to help. Highly recommended for any Shopify store looking for a reliable product options solution!
This is a great app! It does everything that my shopify theme does not do as far as offering options. Best app I've found for variants/options. Customer service has also been very timely and helpful.

WowOptions is an absolute game-changer! The interface is slick, modern, and effortless to use. I was able to set up all my product options in minutes, and the customizability is top-notch. It runs smoothly, looks great on the storefront, and integrates without a single glitch. 10/10 recommendation!
Great app; if you need help, it will be explained and helped straight away.
Insane app, easy ui/ux and easy to make options.

When I first used this app, after seeing its features, I immediately felt like I should give it a review on the App Store. Because I think this app is a must-have for anyone who has a store on Shopify and does business online. Its features will blow your mind. I think every Shopify store owner should definitely use this app. If I had the chance, I would have given this app a 10 out of 5. I would highly recommend using this app at least once . Awesome. I really like this app.
best options app from all that I tried, and support is incredible

The product has a wealth of features, and it promptly helps me with any issues. Most importantly, it offers excellent value for money. I think it's a truly worthwhile plugin, supporting percentage-based price increases.

The plugin is great. The support I received is even better. The developer went out of his way to show me how my product will work using their plugin. And their demo site gives you a bunch of cool ideas. Overall design and performance is very responsive. Options work well. And the free plan is pretty generous as well. Definitely give it a try.

I've been looking for an easy way to add product customization options, and this app works really well. It makes managing different product options much easier.
